sloka: धनूंषि च विचित्राणि राक्षसानां जयैषिणाम् ।प्रगृहीतान्यशोभन्त वानरानभिधावताम् ।। ६.५८.८ ।।।।
transliteration: dhanūṁṣi ca vicitrāṇi rākṣasānāṁ jayaiṣiṇām ।pragṛhītānyaśobhanta vānarānabhidhāvatām ।। 6.58.8 ।।।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas rushing towards Vanaras seeking victory, seizing swords, javelins, double edged swords, pikes, mallets, maces, iron bars, spears and bows of different kinds shone brightly.
